# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

pytubekit is a Python CLI (entry point `pytubekit.main:main`) for bulk operations on a YouTube account via the YouTube Data API v3 — playlist cleanup, dedup, merge, diff, downloads.

## Generated files — do not hand-edit

`pyproject.toml`, `README.md`, `LICENSE`, `requirements.thawed.txt`, and `src/pytubekit/static.py` are generated by pydmt from Mako templates. To change them, edit the source instead and regenerate:

- Templates: `templates/*.mako`
- Project metadata (name, version, deps, author): `config/*.py`
- Regenerate: `pydmt build` (this is also what CI runs)

## Checks

Run the full local check suite before considering work done:

```
make all
```

This runs, in order: `pytest tests`, `ruff check src config tests`, `pylint src config tests`, `mypy src config tests`, and a ripgrep check that fails if any Python file contains an unescaped single quote.

## Code style

- Double-quoted strings only — unescaped `'` in .py files fails the build (see check above).
- Line length: 130 (ruff).
- No formatter is used; ruff is a linter only. Ignore the "black" badge in README — it's a stale template artifact.

## Gotchas

- Mutating commands are dry-run by default; they require `--do-delete` to actually change anything.
- YouTube Data API v3 has a 10,000 units/day quota; prefer the local/dump-file commands (`local_diff`, `local_dedup`, etc.) when possible. API responses are paginated at 50 items (handled by `PagedRequest` in `util.py`).
- Tests mock the YouTube API — no network or credentials needed for `pytest tests`.
- Auth is OAuth2 via `pygooglehelper` using the bundled `src/pytubekit/client_secret.json`; no environment variables are required.
